# function: fsx_association

Builds the ARN for `fsx` `association`:

```
arn:${Partition}:fsx:${Region}:${Account}:association/${FileSystemIdOrFileCacheId}/${DataRepositoryAssociationId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:fsx:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:association/file-system-id-or-file-cache-id/data-repository-association-id
output "fsx_association" {
  value = provider::arn::fsx_association("file-system-id-or-file-cache-id", "data-repository-association-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
fsx_association(file_system_id_or_file_cache_id string, data_repository_association_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `file_system_id_or_file_cache_id` (String) Value for `${FileSystemIdOrFileCacheId}` in the ARN template.
1. `data_repository_association_id` (String) Value for `${DataRepositoryAssociationId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
